page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u2i-c1m8.xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the ecs.u2i family. It is powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon CPU running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz, delivering 4 virtual central processing units (vCPUs). The instance is provisioned with 32.0 GB of system memory, resulting in a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. It utilizes the KVM hypervisor to manage virtualization.

This server type does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external network-attached block storage. It features a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation combined with a high memory density of 8.0 GB per core provides a balanced resource profile for memory-intensive workloads without the overhead of local storage hardware.

Given the 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the ecs.u2i-c1m8.xlarge is designed for memory-optimized workloads. It is suitable for hosting small to medium-sized databases, caching layers, in-memory data processing, and enterprise applications that require a larger memory footprint relative to compute capacity.
